title: 第208章 古卷谶言藏内诡险关列阵出奇谋第207章 鏖战残舵摧魔伏纵敌残遁守遗经
content_zh:
第208章古卷谶言藏内诡，险关列阵出奇谋
众人肃清殿内残余魔兵，沿着高台后方石阶一路走到大殿深处。
厚重石门之上刻满清音宗古老纹路，石门中央凹槽，恰好与蔡文姬掌心的双鱼玉佩虚影轮廓吻合。
蔡文姬调出近乎实物的双鱼玉佩虚影，试着嵌入凹槽。
“嗡……”
温润金光自玉佩蔓延，石门纹路逐一亮起，伴随着低沉厚重的声响，巨大石门缓缓向两侧开启。
石室之内干燥整洁，并未被沼泽泥水侵蚀。
中央石台摆放着三卷泛黄玉册，墙壁上刻满壁画，记录着千年前魔渊裂隙爆发、墨渊以身封印、清汐布设五处分舵镇守地脉的过往。
蔡文姬缓步走上石台，伸手轻轻拿起第一卷玉册。
文字古老晦涩，依靠血脉共鸣方能读懂。
她逐行阅览，心神愈发沉重。
玉册之上清晰记载：右护法所追求的“魔音合一”功法存在致命缺陷，一旦大成，将会彻底丧失人性，沦为魔渊本源的傀儡。
他妄图打通断魂渊主裂隙，不是想要掌控魔渊，而是打算释放魔渊本体，换取无尽力量。
第二卷玉册，记载【十魂分证道】完整奥义。
想要铸就无漏元婴，必须分化神魂，以十种不同身份体悟世间百态，集齐十种大道功德，最终神魂合一，方能抵御魔渊本源侵蚀。
这恰好印证蔡文姬自身血脉枷锁！
第三卷玉册末尾，留下一段清汐夫人亲手写下的预言：
“十魂归一时，清音镇渊门，邪源自内起，莫惧眼前人。”
“邪源自内起……”蔡文姬低声反复念诵这句话，心底升起一丝寒意。
预言预示，除了右护法之外，联军内部，或许潜藏着来自魔渊的暗棋。

杨玉环走到她身侧，看着壁画尽头的地图：
“玉册附带完整断魂渊地形图，标注出三条通路，其中一条密道可以避开正面魔军主营，直抵封印核心。”
西施望向地图标记的断魂渊方向，轻声道：
“穿过南沼北端隘口，便是断魂渊外围区域。那里魔气浓度远超南沼，右护法主力长期驻守，将会是西征以来最严峻的关卡。”
蔡文姬将三卷玉册小心翼翼收好，抬眼看向众人。
“秘卷信息已经探明，传令全军，就地休整一日，补齐丹药、修复军械，明日破晓，全军拔营，进军断魂渊！”
残舵之内，千年琴纹静静泛光。
所有线索汇聚一处，终极战场的轮廓，已然清晰浮现。
距离魔渊封印，距离营救父亲，距离与右护法的宿命对决，越来越近。
一夜休整转瞬即逝。
天边刚泛白，清音分舵外的沼泽滩涂上便响起此起彼伏的号角。
联军将士收拾行囊、检修兵刃，扁鹊带领医帐清点丹药伤药，黄忠的炮队完成弹药装填，一尊尊攻城重炮对准北方隘口方向。
西施立于水边，抬手催动水系灵力清理河道淤泥，开辟出一条可供队伍快速通行的水路。
经过一夜调息，她肩头魅音魔使留下的魔毒已被清音压制，但神魂深处的锁魂禁制依旧如同跗骨之蛆，时不时传来阵阵刺痛。
“向北三十里便是断云隘。”西施铺开地形图，指尖落在狭长险要的山道。
“这是离开南沼、通往断魂渊外围的唯一陆路通道。隘口两侧悬崖绝壁，中间通路狭窄，易守难攻。”
content_en:
Chapter 208 The prophecy of the ancient scrolls hides the hidden secrets, and the dangerous situation leads to strange plans.
Everyone cleared away the remaining demon soldiers in the hall and walked along the stone steps behind the high platform to the depths of the hall.
The thick stone door is engraved with the ancient patterns of the Qingyin Sect. The groove in the center of the stone door coincides with the outline of the Pisces jade pendant in Cai Wenji's palm.
Cai Wenji created a nearly real-life image of the Pisces jade pendant and tried to fit it into the groove.
"Buzz..."
Warm golden light spread from the jade pendant, and the lines on the stone door lit up one by one. With a deep and heavy sound, the huge stone door slowly opened to both sides.
The stone chamber is dry and clean, and has not been corroded by swamp mud and water.
Three volumes of yellow jade are placed on the central stone platform, and the walls are covered with murals, recording the past of the Moyuan rift erupting thousands of years ago, Mo Yuan sealing it with his body, and Qing tide deploying five rudders to guard the earth's veins.
Cai Wenji walked slowly onto the stone platform, reached out and gently picked up the first jade volume.
The text is ancient and obscure, and it can only be understood by relying on blood resonance.
She read line by line, feeling increasingly heavy.
It is clearly recorded on the jade book: The "Demon Sound Unification" technique pursued by the right protector has a fatal flaw. Once it is completed, it will completely lose its humanity and become a puppet of the origin of the devil.
He tried to open up the main rift of the Soul-Desolating Abyss, not to control the Demonic Abyss, but to release the Demonic Abyss itself in exchange for endless power.
The second volume of the jade book records the complete secret of "The Enlightenment of Ten Souls".
If you want to create a flawless Nascent Soul, you must separate your soul, experience the world in ten different identities, and gather ten great virtues. Only then can your soul and soul be unified into one to resist the erosion of the origin of the devil.
This just proves that Cai Wenji’s own bloodline is shackles!
At the end of the third volume of the jade book, there is a prophecy written by Mrs. Qingxi herself:
"When the ten souls return to one, the clear sound suppresses the Yuanmen. Evil originates from within. Don't be afraid of the person in front of you."
"Evil comes from within..." Cai Wenji recited this sentence repeatedly in a low voice, feeling a chill rise in her heart.
The prophecy indicates that, in addition to the Right Protector, there may be hidden plots from the Demonic Abyss within the coalition forces.
Yang Yuhuan walked to her side and looked at the map at the end of the mural:
"The jade book comes with a complete topographic map of the Broken Soul Abyss, which marks three passages. One of the secret passages can avoid the main camp of the demon army in front and reach the core of the seal."
Xi Shi looked towards the direction of Duanhunyuan marked on the map and said softly:
"Going through the pass at the northern end of South Marsh is the outer area of Soul-Desolating Abyss. The concentration of demonic energy there far exceeds that of South Marsh, and the main force of the right guardian will be stationed for a long time. It will be the most severe level since the Western Expedition."
Cai Wenji carefully put away the three jade volumes and raised her eyes to look at everyone.
"The information in the secret scroll has been discovered, and the entire army is ordered to rest on the spot for a day, replenish the elixirs, and repair ordnance. At dawn tomorrow, the entire army will break camp and march into the Soul-Desolating Abyss!"
Within the remaining rudder, the thousand-year-old piano pattern is quietly glowing.
All the clues come together, and the outline of the ultimate battlefield has clearly emerged.
He is getting closer and closer to the seal of the Demonic Abyss, to rescuing his father, and to the fateful showdown with the Right Protector.
A night's rest is fleeting.
As soon as the sky turned white, horns sounded one after another on the swamp beach outside the Qingyin branch.
The coalition soldiers packed their bags and inspected their weapons. Bian Que led the medical account to count the elixirs and medicines for wounds. Huang Zhong's artillery team completed loading ammunition, and the heavy siege artillery was aimed in the direction of the northern pass.
Xi Shi stood at the water's edge, raising her hand to activate the water system's spiritual power to clear the river mud and open up a waterway for the team to pass quickly.
After a night of adjusting her breath, the poison left by the Meiyin Demon on her shoulder has been suppressed by Qingyin, but the soul-locking restriction deep in her soul is still like maggots on the tarsal bones, causing bursts of stinging pain from time to time.
"Thirty miles to the north is Duanyun Pass." Xi Shi spread out the terrain map and placed his fingertips on the long, narrow and dangerous mountain road.
"This is the only land passage leaving Nanmo and leading to the outskirts of the Broken Soul Abyss. There are cliffs on both sides of the pass, and the passage in the middle is narrow, making it easy to defend but difficult to attack."
